title: Volcanoes for kids
examples: What is the difference between magma and lava?

explain.say: A volcano is a mountain with an opening at the top. Hot stuff from inside can push out.
Now look. This is the inside of a volcano in 3D. Can you see the ash cloud and the crater? Tap any part to hear about it.
Deep under the ground, rock is so hot that it melts. This melted rock is called magma.
When magma comes out onto the surface, it is called lava.
When a volcano pushes out lava, ash or gas, it is called an eruption.
Volcanoes can send out ash. Ash is made of fine bits of rock.

items: It flies high in the air

explain.say: Think of a shaken fizzy drink. When you open it, the gas pushes out. Gas builds up inside a volcano in the same way.

faq.q: What is the difference between magma and lava?
faq.a: Magma is the melted rock found deep inside the Earth. Lava is what the magma becomes once it flows out onto the surface.

faq.q: What causes a volcano to erupt?
faq.a: A volcano erupts because the pressure from the trapped melted rock, the magma, gets too strong. This force pushes everything out.
asks: What makes the volcano go boom?

faq.q: Is the ash from a volcano dangerous?
faq.a: Ash makes the air dusty. People who live near volcanoes listen to scientists, who help them stay safe.
asks: What is volcanic ash made of?

faq.q: Do all volcanoes erupt the same way?
faq.a: No, volcanoes can erupt in many different ways. Some might flow slowly with lava, while others might send out ash very high.
asks: What kinds of eruptions are there?

faq.a: Lava can flow over the land, but it cools down and hardens over time. When it cools, it becomes solid rock.

facts: Magma is found beneath the Earth's surface.
Lava is molten rock that flows from a volcano.
Ash is made of tiny fragments of rock and glass.
Volcanic eruptions are caused by building pressure.

quiz.say: What is the melted rock under the ground called?
quiz.why: Melted rock under the ground is called magma.

wrong.1: Ash is fine bits of rock in the air.
wrong.2: Sand is tiny grains, like on a beach.

quiz.say: Melted rock comes out of the volcano. What is it called now?
quiz.show: 🌋 Out on the ground, it is…
quiz.why: Melted rock on the surface is called lava.

wrong.0: It is called magma only while it is under the ground.
wrong.2: Ice is frozen water, and lava is very hot.

quiz.say: A volcano pushes out lava and ash. What is this called?
quiz.why: An eruption is when a volcano pushes out lava, ash or gas.

wrong.0: Ash is one thing that comes out, but the whole event has its own name.
wrong.1: Magma is the melted rock under the ground.
